description: DJ-style English test set for the emotional TTS comparison (issue #4): 7 emotions x 5 sentences. The 'shared' sentence is identical for every emotion, so only the voice can carry the emotion (controllability). 'content' sentences already fit their emotion, like real announcements. Items with listen=true go into the blind listening test (2 per emotion).
